goal: Review FA-275 read-only evidence and decide the next safe depreciation route after post-acquisition OK still produced no visible FADEP-273-OK journal line.
decisionQuestions: Does FA-275 justify any repeat Calculate Depreciation OK? If yes, why is repeating safe despite no visible output? If no, document the stop.
Is the most likely next step a deeper read-only output-target/batch diagnosis, a setup-fit plan, or a narrower Page Inspection/personalization diagnosis?
Can Preview Posting be unlocked only if a real depreciation journal line exists? If no line exists, keep Preview and Post locked.
What exact beginner-facing explanation belongs in the book for OK-without-visible-output?
acceptanceCriteria: FA-275 evidence is reviewed without opening Business Central.
The missing FADEP-273-OK journal output is classified against eligibility, output-target and UI visibility hypotheses.
Repeat OK, Preview Posting and Post remain locked unless the decision explicitly proves why a narrower next live step is safe.
The next case is specific and smaller than another uncontrolled depreciation run.
stopConditions: Any proposal opens Preview Posting without a visible depreciation journal line.
Any proposal repeats OK without new evidence explaining why FA-273/FA-275 showed no output.
Any proposal treats post-acquisition date alone as a successful depreciation proof.
nextSafeAction: Run a read-only Page Inspection / value diagnosis for FA-CNC-01/HGB depreciation-book fields: Depreciation Starting Date, No. of Depreciation Years, Depreciation Ending Date, Book Value, Last Depreciation Date if available, and journal batch/output target signals.

result.summary: FA-276 rejects repeat OK, Preview Posting and Post. FA-275 needs narrower read-only value proof for FA-CNC-01/HGB depreciation-book fields before any further execution route.
